_comment: Pack EN 14 (user requests of 2026-10-16): the ambulance leaves or the dispatch is cancelled because of it (AMB.*), the voices of the doctor during the hoist operations (HST.*), the heli rescuer during the hoist operations (HRS.*), the farewell to the heli rescuers left at the hospital, the base or the meeting point (HRD.*), the radio call to the heli rescue base before the pick-up (HRQ.*), the names of the dispatcher by group of the CARLS (DSP.NAME.*, see <dsp:INDEX:CITY>). Actor 12 is the Heli rescuer. Arguments: {hr:N} one or two heli rescuers, {place:N} the place (H hospital, B base, M meeting point), {0} a number or the city.

AMB.DEP.DSP.trigger: the ambulance has loaded the patient and leaves for the hospital (the dispatcher tells it)
o: {@PLT}, {@DSP}. The ambulance has loaded the patient and is on its way to the hospital.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. Ground unit has the patient aboard and is transporting to the hospital.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. The ambulance is leaving the scene with the patient, bound for the hospital.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. Patient loaded on the ambulance, they are heading to the hospital now.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. The ambulance took the patient and is rolling to the hospital.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. Good news, the ambulance has the patient and is driving to the hospital.

AMB.CAN.DSP.trigger: the dispatch is cancelled because the ground units take every patient
o: {@HEMS}, {@DSP}. Your dispatch is cancelled, the ambulance takes care of all the patients. Thank you, return to base.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. Cancel the dispatch, the ground units are transporting everybody. Return to base, thank you.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. We cancel your tasking: the patients are in the ambulance. You can go back to base.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. Dispatch cancelled, the ambulance has the patients. Thanks for the availability, return to base.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. You are released, the ambulance has everything under control. Back to base.
{@HEMS}, {@DSP}. Stand down, the ambulance is handling it all. Thanks, and return to base.

HST.ARR.S.trigger: hoist operation: the doctor reaches a stable patient
o: Doc at the patient. Stable, I start the assessment.
Doc at the patient. He looks stable, assessment under way.
I am with the patient. Looks stable, starting the check.
Patient reached, he seems stable. I begin the assessment.
Reached the patient. Stable for now, I am checking him over.
At the patient, looks stable. Let me have a proper look.

HST.ARR.M.trigger: hoist operation: the doctor reaches a serious patient
o: Doc at the patient. Serious condition, I start the assessment.
Doc at the patient. He is in a serious state, assessment under way.
I am with the patient. Serious, starting the check right away.
Patient reached, the condition is serious. I begin the assessment.
Reached the patient. This one is serious, I am checking him now.
At the patient, and he is not well. Serious, I am on it.

HST.ARR.C.trigger: hoist operation: the doctor reaches a critical patient
o: Doc at the patient. Critical condition, treatment starts now.
Doc at the patient. He is critical, I start the treatment at once.
I am with the patient. Critical, no time to lose.
Patient reached, he is critical. Starting the treatment immediately.
Reached the patient. Critical, I am treating him now.
At the patient, and it is critical. Treatment starts right now.

HST.DONE.S.trigger: hoist operation: the doctor finishes the visit of a stable patient
o: Assessment complete. The patient is stable, ready for the transport.
Assessment done. He is stable, we can move him.
Check complete, the patient is stable and ready to go.
All done here. Stable, ready for the transport.
Done with the patient. Stable and ready to move.
Finished. He is stable and ready for the ride.

HST.DONE.M.trigger: hoist operation: the doctor finishes the visit of a serious patient
o: Assessment and treatment complete. Serious but stabilised, ready for the transport.
Treatment done. The patient is serious but stabilised, we can move him.
Check and treatment complete, still serious, ready to go.
All done here. Serious but stable enough for the transport.
Done with the patient. Serious, but he can travel.
Finished. Still serious, but ready for the ride.

HST.DONE.C.trigger: hoist operation: the doctor finishes the visit of a critical patient
o: Treatment complete. The patient is critical, we must move now.
Treatment done. He is critical, we need to go without delay.
Everything I can do here is done. Critical, let us move.
All done here. Critical patient, ready for the transport, fast.
Done with the patient. Critical, we need to leave now.
Finished. He is critical, ready to go, please hurry.

HRS.START.trigger: the heli rescuer starts to be lowered to secure the area
o: Heli rescuer on the cable, going down to secure the area.
Heli rescuer going down now, I secure the area.
On the cable, going down. I will secure the area.
Going down to the scene. I will secure the area first.
Heli rescuer leaving the cabin, I take care of the scene.
Down I go, I will have the scene secure for the crew.

o: Half way down, the area looks clear.

Passing half, no hazards in sight.
Half way down, no problems seen below.

Half way down, nothing to worry about so far.

HRS.DONE.trigger: the heli rescuer is on the ground and the area is secure
o: Heli rescuer on the ground. Area secure, all okay.
On the ground. The area is secured, everything is okay.
Heli rescuer down. Area secure, you can proceed.

On the ground, area secured. All okay, you are clear to proceed.

Thanks for the support. See you next time.

Thanks a lot for the help, take care out there.

HRD.HRT.trigger: the heli rescuers have left the helicopter: a rescuer answers
o: Thanks to you. Safe flight.
Our pleasure. Safe flight.
Thank you too. Fly safe.
Any time. Fly safe.
Thanks, glad to help. Safe flight.
Always a pleasure. Fly safe.
